# Data36

> Data36 is a practical learning platform for aspiring data scientists, offering tutorials, career guidance, and equipment recommendations from industry expert Tomi Mester.

Data36 focuses on demystifying data science education and career development through hands-on SQL and Python tutorials, along with pragmatic advice for beginners entering the field. The site emphasizes both technical skills and real-world expectations.

## Key Topics

- SQL
- Python
- Data Science
- Learning Data Science
- Career Guide
- Beginner Guide
- Statistical Analysis
- SQL Functions
- Hardware Recommendations
- Laptop Guide
- MacBook Pro
- Dell XPS
- Remote Server Setup
- Tomi Mester
- Online Education

## SQL & Data Analysis Tutorials

- [SQL functions (SUM, COUNT, MIN, MAX, AVG) and GROUP BY (tutorial)](https://data36.com/sql-functions-beginners-tutorial-ep3): SQL tutorial covering aggregate functions (SUM, COUNT, AVG, MIN, MAX) and GROUP BY.
- [Statistical Averages - Mean, Median and Mode - Data36](https://data36.com/statistical-averages-mean-median-mode): Tutorial on statistical averages: mean, median, mode and central tendency.

## Data Science Career & Learning

- [Learning Data Science in 2023 (4 Untold Truths)](https://data36.com/learning-data-science): Tomi Mester explores untold truths about learning data science and career development.

## Tools & Equipment

- [What's the best computer/laptop for a data scientist in 2023?](https://data36.com/best-computer-laptop-for-a-data-scientist): Hardware recommendations for data scientists: MacBook Pro, Dell XPS comparisons.
